purpose: What the seven workflow stages do today, taken from the code, so that nothing is lost unnoticed in the 3.0 rebuild. Every entry is checked against the code by tests/preservation-register.spec.ts; where this file and the code disagree, the test fails and the code wins.

rules.changeReason: Roadmap 0.7: sechs Felder verlassen die Client-Allowlist und werden nur noch von POST /api/projects/{projectId}/commands geschrieben — die fuenf Freigabefelder (`targetArchitecture`, `approvedByArchitect`, `architectJustifiedOverride`, `architectSignOffAt`, `approvedBy`) und `usageReport`. Der Browser bestimmte bis dahin selbst, welche Adresse in `approvedBy` stand, und `usageReport` war nur als `is map` geprueft. Vorheriger Stand: b1cad225116df03d441bfa86f13197b6cd1d632960dc7a051ce02c5749eae106 (davor: der Wegfall des Admin-Lesezugriffs am 16.09.2026, 96ece81b991cfeac4c5b0033e333e47ae9459c1fb825292c29e92fc69ec7fbe2). Welche Fassung ausgerollt ist, steht in docs/registers/rules-deployment.json — CI rollt die Regeln nie aus.

run.note: `analysis` is the model narrative. Only its SHA-256 goes into the signed payload, as aiNarrativeMeta.responseHash with evidentiary: false. Roadmap 1.2: a run may have no narrative at all — `modelParticipation` is 'none', `model.provider`, `model.modelId`, `aiNarrativeMeta.provider`, `aiNarrativeMeta.modelId` and `aiNarrativeMeta.responseHash` are null, the input manifest records `model:narrative` at revision 'none', and the run is signed over the deterministic evidence exactly as any other. Model receipt (16.09.2026): `modelParticipation` has a third value and the run gains no field for it. 'narrative-attested' means /api/gemini issued a receipt over exactly the submitted narrative for this uid inside a 10-minute window (lib/model-receipt.ts, HMAC over AUDIT_SIGNING_KEY, domain-separated from the run signature) and /api/runs/create verified it — only then do `model.provider`, `model.modelId`, `aiNarrativeMeta.provider`, `aiNarrativeMeta.modelId` carry a value, `model.byokUsed` comes from the receipt rather than the profile, and the manifest records `model:narrative` at 'google-gemini/<modelId>'. 'narrative' means a narrative is present and its origin was not established: the same four fields are null, `aiNarrativeMeta.responseHash` is still the digest of the stored text, and the manifest records `model:narrative` at revision 'unattested'. A missing or invalid receipt never refuses a run.

hydration.rule: project document, then the active run spread over it — the run wins on every shared key.
hydration.onMissingRun: _runLoadFailed = true, _runLoadError set; in-memory only, never persisted.
hydration.consequence: Every field in projectFieldsDeletedByRunsCreate reaches a stage only through hydration. A reader that does not hydrate (the dashboard) never sees them.

serverOnlyProjectFields.journal: audit_events — geschrieben vom Admin-SDK (logAuditEvent), fuer keinen Client les- oder schreibbar
serverOnlyProjectFields.reason: Die fuenf Freigabefelder und der Nutzungsimport. Eine Freigabe entsteht auf dem Server oder gar nicht: der Browser schrieb bis Roadmap 0.7 auch `approvedBy`, also die Adresse, die auf der Freigabe steht. Sie kommt jetzt vom verifizierten ID-Token, der Zeitstempel von der Serveruhr. `usageReport` war in den Regeln nur als `is map` geprueft (Security-Audit v2.11.0); die Route haelt ihn auf den Schluesselsatz von lib/abap/usage-model.ts und eine Zeilenobergrenze.
serverOnlyProjectFields.stillAttestedNotSigned: Der Audit-Pack fuehrt diese Felder weiterhin in 07-user-attested.md: sie bleiben eine Selbsterklaerung des angemeldeten Kontos. Servervalidiert heisst wahrheitsgemaess aufgezeichnet, nicht amtlich.

knownLimits.subject: testing
knownLimits.statement: No client path writes a verdict onto project.testCases[].status. POST /api/run-tests writes the verdicts it observed, with the Admin SDK, in the same write as testRunReceipt; the testing page only mirrors that answer into its own state.
knownLimits.consequence: Testing — and therefore Delivery — is reachable by running the suite, and green only behind the receipt: a row of owner-written Passed strings is 'done' and 'Self-reported', never proven. Before 2026-09-17 nothing stored the verdicts, so the honest path could not reach 'done' at all (QA 6c38e0c7c620).
knownLimits.evidence: app/api/run-tests/route.ts sets { testCases, testRunReceipt } in one merge; hooks/useTestExecution.ts writes only generatedCode and testSuite to Firestore and mirrors the rest through setProject; hooks/useTestGeneration.ts writes testCases without a status field.

knownLimits.subject: delivery
knownLimits.statement: workflowSteps() Delivery counts only generated code, tests and documentation as gaps. A missing architect sign-off is not a gap.
knownLimits.consequence: The contract would report Delivery 'done' beside Design 'partial (Awaiting sign-off)' if every test passed. Only L-01 keeps that combination out of reach today.

knownLimits.subject: delivery
knownLimits.statement: businessDocumentation and testSuite go into the delivery ZIP but are not in stalenessTrackedArtefacts.
knownLimits.consequence: A bundle for the current source can contain a business SOP and a test suite written for the previous one, and nothing says so.

knownLimits.subject: documentation
knownLimits.statement: The blueprint prompt is built from 1,000-character slices of generatedCode, solutionDesign and analysis.
knownLimits.consequence: A business rule beyond the first 1,000 characters cannot reach the blueprint (QA24-A10).

knownLimits.subject: analyze
knownLimits.statement: Analyze and Economics are the only stages that render no StaleNotice, although both can be PhaseState 'stale'.
knownLimits.consequence: On those two stages a stale state is visible in the stepper circle and nowhere in prose.
knownLimits.evidence: StaleNotice is imported by design, transformation, documentation, testing and delivery only.

knownLimits.subject: design
knownLimits.statement: The design page auto-generates on load whenever an analysis exists and no solutionDesign does, without a user action and without a generationBlockers target of its own.
knownLimits.consequence: Opening stage 2 spends a model call. generationBlockers has no 'design' target, so the only thing that stops it is that a design already exists.
knownLimits.evidence: app/(app)/project/[projectId]/design/page.tsx, the fetchProject effect; lib/workflow-steps.ts generationBlockers signature.

knownLimits.subject: hydration
knownLimits.statement: The run document carries status: 'completed'; the hydrated project therefore always reads status 'completed', whatever the project document says.
knownLimits.consequence: Harmless only because lib/workflow-steps.ts refuses to read `status`. Any future reader of project.status on a hydrated project reads the run's value.
knownLimits.evidence: app/api/runs/create/route.ts (run status 'completed', project status 'analyzed'); lib/project-loader.ts spread order.

knownLimits.subject: rules
knownLimits.statement: `presentation` is client-writable by firestore.rules and written by nothing.
knownLimits.consequence: An owner can put up to 1 MB of arbitrary text on their own project under a name the delivery page once used. Nothing reads it, so it is surface without a purpose rather than a leak.
knownLimits.evidence: firestore.rules allowlist and isValidProject; no stage page, hook or route sets `presentation`.

knownLimits.subject: economics
knownLimits.statement: Economics can never be PhaseState 'done' in this release, and workflowSummary().next skips it.
knownLimits.consequence: Deliberate (CR-23 / E12-F02): the model runs on assumed effort coefficients, not observed costs.

outputs.note: The page does not store the verdicts it shows and no client path writes one. POST /api/run-tests writes the verdicts it observed together with testRunReceipt, in one Admin-SDK write — what the server saw, the server records — bound to the active run and to the digests of generatedCode, testSuite and testCases (the case digest ignores status and message, so storing a verdict cannot freshen or retire a receipt). testRunReceipt is outside the client allowlist of firestore.rules; testCases is inside it, which is why lib/workflow-steps.ts counts passes for `proven` from the receipt and reads client-written Passed strings as 'Self-reported'. generatedCode and testSuite are rewritten only by the auto-heal path in useTestExecution, which repairs the one file repairTarget() names.
